metadata.question: On February 26, 2025, were there at least three distinct tropical cyclones visible visible between 0 and 40 degrees South?

data.raw_code:

1. Search strategy: Use NOAA IBTrACS V4 global tropical cyclone tracks, filter for 2025-02-26 by both system time and iso_time string, then spatially filter to latitudes 0 to 40°S (rectangle -180,-40 to 180,0). 
2. Masking strategy: Not applicable (vector dataset). Focus on robust filtering for “tropical” nature or wind >= 34 kt.
3. Logic for Valid Zero vs Null: If 0 storms found, that’s a valid “No” (B). If collection load or evaluation fails, output D. If computation returns undefined/NaN, output C3.

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    const dateStr = '2025-02-26';
    const start = ee.Date(dateStr + 'T00:00:00');
    const end = start.advance(1, 'day');
    const southBand = ee.Geometry.Rectangle({coords: [-180, -40, 180, 0], geodesic: false});
    const ibtracs = ee.FeatureCollection('NOAA/IBTrACS/V4');

    // Helper to evaluate ee objects
    const ev = (obj) => new Promise((res, rej) => obj.evaluate((v, e) => e ? rej(e) : res(v)));

    // Try time-based filter first, then fallback to iso_time string filter
    const byTime = ibtracs.filterDate(start, end);
    const sizeByTime = await ev(byTime.size());

    const byStr = ibtracs.filter(ee.Filter.stringContains('iso_time', dateStr));
    const sizeByStr = await ev(byStr.size());

    // Merge both (avoid missing due to absent system time); keep only date rows by either method.
    const timeUnion = (sizeByTime > 0) ? byTime : ee.FeatureCollection([]);
    const strUnion = (sizeByStr > 0) ? byStr : ee.FeatureCollection([]);
    const dayFC = timeUnion.merge(strUnion);

    const dayCount = await ev(dayFC.size());
    const dayInBand = dayFC.filterBounds(southBand);
    const dayInBandCount = await ev(dayInBand.size());

    // Tropical-only filter if available; else fallback to wind >=34 kt (TS)
    const tcOnly = dayInBand.filter(ee.Filter.equals('nature', 'TC'));
    const tcOnlyCount = await ev(tcOnly.size());
    const windUSA = dayInBand.filter(ee.Filter.gte('usa_wind', 34));
    const windWMO = dayInBand.filter(ee.Filter.gte('wmo_wind', 34));
    const windAny = windUSA.merge(windWMO);
    const windAnyCount = await ev(windAny.size());

    const candidate = (tcOnlyCount > 0) ? tcOnly : windAny;
    const candCount = (tcOnlyCount > 0) ? tcOnlyCount : windAnyCount;

    // Distinct storms by sid if present, else by name-season key
    const hasAny = candCount > 0;
    let distinctCount = 0;
    let stormList = [];
    if (hasAny) {
      // Try sid
      const first = ee.Feature(candidate.first());
      const sidSample = await ev(first.get('sid'));
      let keyed = candidate;
      if (sidSample !== null && sidSample !== undefined) {
        keyed = candidate.distinct(['sid']);
        distinctCount = await ev(keyed.size());
        // names for evidence (compact)
        stormList = await ev(keyed.aggregate_array('name'));
      } else {
        const withKey = candidate.map(f => {
          const nm = ee.String(ee.Algorithms.If(f.get('name'), f.get('name'), 'UNKNOWN'));
          const sn = ee.String(ee.Algorithms.If(f.get('season'), ee.Number(f.get('season')).format(), 'UNK'));
          return f.set('key', nm.cat('-').cat(sn));
        });
        keyed = withKey.distinct(['key']);
        distinctCount = await ev(keyed.size());
        stormList = await ev(keyed.aggregate_array('key'));
      }
    }

    // Prints (<=20 lines)
    console.log(`IBTrACS total (all years): ${await ev(ibtracs.size())}`);
    console.log(`On ${dateStr}: timeFilter=${sizeByTime}, strFilter=${sizeByStr}, merged=${dayCount}`);
    console.log(`In 0–40S band (features): ${dayInBandCount}`);
    console.log(`Tropical-only (nature=TC): ${tcOnlyCount}, Wind>=34 kt fallback: ${windAnyCount}`);
    console.log(`Candidate features after filters: ${candCount}`);
    console.log(`Distinct storms (IDs): ${distinctCount}`);
    if (hasAny) {
      const listStr = (stormList || []).slice(0, 6).join(', ');
      console.log(`Storms (sample up to 6): ${listStr}`);
    }

    // Decide final answer
    if (!isFinite(distinctCount)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    if (distinctCount >= 3) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    // If dataset or method error
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
